info.name: SGITU - G10 Gateway x G1 Billetterie
info.description: Collection Postman exhaustive cote Gateway pour verifier Client -> G10 -> G1 Billetterie. Elle couvre JWT, RBAC, routage, headers Gateway, endpoints tickets utilisateur, endpoints admin reels et resilience 503. Les ticket-types sont documentes comme non exposes par G1 actuellement.

exec: const payload = { sub: email, userId: String(userId), roles: roles, iat: now, exp: now + ttlSeconds, jti: 'g1-postman-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) };
pm.test('Sans JWT refuse par G10', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('ROLE_PASSENGER refuse sur admin G1', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Cancel ticket route G1 repond', function () { pm.expect([200,400,404,422,503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Refund ticket route G1 repond', function () { pm.expect([200,400,404,422,503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Cancel transfer route G1 repond', function () { pm.expect([200,400,404,422,503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Admin list tickets accessible', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Admin flagged detail route repond', function () { pm.expect([200,404,422,503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Quand G1 est arrete, G10 retourne 503', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(503); });

item.name: 05.1 - 404 ticket-types non expose par G1 actuel

exec: pm.test('Ticket-types non expose actuellement par G1', function () { pm.expect([404,503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Ce test documente le contrat reel G1 actuel', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.eql(401); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.eql(403); });
